dog.description_text:
Due to the detailed behavior issues, this animal is only available for foster/adoption through one of ACC's New Hope Partners. If you are interested in adopting or fostering, please fill out the pre-screener form. This animal is not directly available for adoption through ACC and is only available by completing the pre-screener form.Adoption inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

During his previous stay in care, he was noted to display handling sensitivity and defensive behavior, such as rolling and baring his teeth when restrained for medical exams and snapping and headwhipping during intake when his harness is removed. In care, he has only allowed minimal handling. During his current stay, Bruno was observed to hard bark and lunge towards people. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Bruno
